raw_response: {"diagnosis": "After the 2026-01-15 CRM migration, 60 migrated customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes these through, which splits gold_region_daily into code and name regions. raw_region_map provides the documented mapping from code to name.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT region_code, any_value(region_name) AS region_name FROM raw_region_map GROUP BY region_code) m ON c.region = m.region_code"}}
